fields.name: Sacred Scrolls of the Gizmek Legend

limits: Each Field has one explicitly exercised significant branch; other branches and interaction combinations are not certified.
These are headless native scenarios, with browser integration audited separately.

scenarios.description: A WIND monster makes a real Spell activation cost 500 LP; native End Phase maintenance costs another 500 LP.
Visas satisfies activation; Dark Hole destroys the owned monster and the Field trigger revives it in Defense Position.
The GY ignition targets two genuine Yummy monsters across GY and faceup banishment, returns all three cards and performs a native bottom-deck sort.
A real Normal Summon of Shari triggers the Field; the selected Gunkan card becomes the actual top card of the native deck.
Activation searches genuine Mannadium and grants 100 ATK per owned Tuner on field and in GY, with a non-LIGHT negative control.
The ignition targets a field Ritual and publicly reveals a different-Level Ritual in hand; its native Level changes to eight and resets at End Phase.
A genuine ignition selects an unused Main Monster Zone, installs a Season Counter and increases owned ATK by 400; a later Normal Summon cannot use the blocked zone.
The official ignition places the hand monster and a real Millennium deck monster into Spell/Trap Zones with native Continuous Spell types.
A genuine two-card GY target is sorted onto the deck bottom and followed by exactly one effect draw; the hard once-per-turn ignition then disappears.
An empty Main Monster Zone enables a native hand-to-field Wizard @Ignister summon; the occupied zone then makes another A.I.Land summon unavailable.
Stromberg Special Summons its explicitly listed Hexe Trude partner from Deck, then the native core forbids a still-legal low-Level Normal Summon.
Activation searches White Forest, then a targeted non-Tuner becomes a native Tuner for this turn and resets at End Phase.
Base grants the actual bilateral Deskbot 500 ATK/DEF bonus and recycles two selected hand Deskbot cards to draw exactly two cards.
Five distinct genuine Fur Hire monsters enable the ignition; the Field is sent as cost and destroys both opposing monster and Trap.
With more opposing monsters, World Dino Wrestling banishes itself from GY as cost and Special Summons a native Dinowrestler from Deck.
A real Normal Summon is destroyed and replaced by a Mask Token with the exact destroyed stats; Field destruction destroys the token.
Zodiac Sign gives only the owned Zoodiac 300 ATK/DEF, preserving an opposing Zoodiac and an owned unrelated Beast-Warrior; destruction restores printed stats.
The Field searches Dimension Dice, then rolls two actual native dice in its owner's Battle Phase; recorded rolls determine both ATK changes and End Phase resets them.

fixtureCards.name: Sacred Scrolls of the Gizmek Legend

scenarios.description: The Field changes its current name to King's Sarcophagus and resolves a genuine Horus search followed by a different hand card placed on deck bottom.
Boot Sector resolves its hand mode and summons two distinct native Rokkets in Defense, with the continuous 300 ATK/DEF bonuses.
A genuine opposing Polymerization Fusion Summon triggers the Field and searches Fallen of Albaz from the owner's deck.
Synthesis sends a hand card to GY as a real non-discard cost, selects the zero-DEF Zombie in GY and Special Summons it through the native core.
Network sends official Numeron Calling from Deck as cost, copies its activation effect and summons four distinct Numeron Gates from Extra Deck; End Phase banishes all four.
Lab replaces Destructotron's real 1000 LP activation cost with a Psychic Counter; MST then destroys Lab and the controller takes 1000 effect damage.
An opposing Foolish Burial deck-to-GY event triggers Kingdom: target the opposing monster, send a real DARK Vampire by effect and destroy the target.
Parade prevents effect damage to the opponent; with all defenders facedown, an opposing direct attack does not flip the defender and triggers a genuine Ghostrick search.
The native activation is unavailable until MST destroys an owned Set Spell; with Z-ONE in GY, a real Normal Summon is destroyed and both players take 800 damage.
Revival gives both players' genuine Crusadia Links 500 ATK, excludes an owned Crusadia non-Link and restores stats when removed.
Realm targets a genuine Danger monster and grants a continuing direct attack despite an opposing faceup monster; the native Battle Phase inflicts exactly its ATK.
Pot of Greed's genuine draw triggers Tilted Try: reveal one drawn card, send the Field to GY, place that exact card on deck bottom and draw a replacement.
Matrix grants an Insect Xyz the native 300 ATK/DEF bonus and attaches a selected hand Insect as a real overlay material.
An opposing Blue-Eyes attacks genuinely Xyz-Summoned Rank-4 Dark Rebellion: Territory's damage-calculation-only 800 ATK reverses the battle result, then ATK returns to 2500.
Only the owner controls a Spellcaster, suppressing opposing Spells; battle destroys that Spellcaster, then the opponent regains Spell activation while the owner becomes locked.
A real Xyz Summon establishes Cowboy with two materials; Override replaces its detach activation cost by a face-down hand banishment while Cowboy still inflicts 800 damage.
After an ordinary Normal Summon, Laser Qlip makes a real Qliphort Normal Summon available and the core summons it without Tributes, applying its official Level-4/1800 effect.
Downpour applies the exact -500 ATK/+400 DEF modifier to both players' EARTH monsters, excludes LIGHT and restores stats when MST destroys the Field.
